snippet.title: Saga Frontier [trailer]
snippet.description:
Saga Frontier is one of those games that  always I want to play but never found time to. Game is one of first Square games on PS (I think) and is a typical jRPG themed game. You know, pink haired chicks with big guns chasing EVIL. From what I see on the trailer. Still is one of best according to game rankings.
As I mentioned earlier I never played in this on so if you want more info check wiki:
